dedupe_keys.name: pcaet cadre de depot taux couverture energies renouvelables

description: PCAET - Cadre de Dépôt Taux Couverture Energies Renouvelables is a dataset listed in BourgesPlus OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OREGES. Evolution estimée du taux de couverture de la consommation énergétique du territoire par les énergies renouvelables de 2012 à 2050 Source des données de diagnostic: OREGES Objectifs définis par Bourges Plus Structure du jeu de données: Annee: Année TauxcouvertureconsoEnergieTotaleparENRObj: Objectif pour le taux de couverture de la consommation énergétique du territoire par les énergies renouvelables ... Coverage: Bourges Plus (Cher). The portal files it under Environnement. The portal shows 14 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bourgesplus-fr-portal.
